summary: We are looking for a skilled UI Developer with strong experience in React or Angular to build scalable, high-performance web applications.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain web applications using React.js or Angular
Convert UI/UX designs into high-quality, reusable components
Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility
Collaborate with backend teams to integrate APIs
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews and follow best UI development practices
required_skills: Strong hands-on experience with React.js or Angular
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript
Experience with REST APIs and JSON
Knowledge of responsive design and modern UI frameworks (Bootstrap, Tailwind, Material UI, etc.)
Familiarity with Git and version control
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of unit testing frameworks (Jest, Jasmine, Karma)
Experience working in SaaS or product-based companies
